comingSoon.title: Not available yet
comingSoon.desc: The Seelegent service does not keep these settings yet. They appear here once it does.

appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.desc: Theme, fonts and motion. Saved in this browser only.

workers.label: Workers
workers.desc: How many tasks an account runs at once, time limits and when a worker counts as stuck.

backends.label: Backends
backends.desc: Which command-line tools take work, and the model behind each tier.

quota.label: Quota
quota.desc: How much quota to keep in reserve and how often it is read.

providers.label: API providers
providers.desc: Services that API-key accounts send requests to.

gates.label: Gates
gates.desc: Checks that must pass before work counts as done.

workspace.label: Workspace safety
workspace.desc: Guards that keep workers from stepping on each other’s files and on your repository.

hooks.label: Hooks
hooks.desc: Shell commands the service runs when a task starts, finishes or fails, or an account needs you.

memory.label: Memory
memory.desc: Project facts given to every worker.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.desc: When and how Seelegent tells you something needs you.

system.label: Service
system.desc: The Seelegent service itself: its port and background jobs.

language.label: Language
language.desc: Language of the dashboard. Changes apply at once.

resources.label: Resources
resources.desc: How much of this machine the workers, gate commands and the service may use. Changes apply without a restart: running work keeps its limits, the next start gets the new ones.

daemon.offline: The settings load when the dashboard is connected to the Seelegent service.
daemon.rangeWhole: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
daemon.lines: One per line; saved when you leave the field.
daemon.readonly: Set when the service starts (seelegent config); it cannot change here.
daemon.osOther: {os} only: has no effect on the system the service runs on.
daemon.criticalBelowMin: The emergency memory floor must be below Free memory to start while both are on.
daemon.useAutoOf: Set {name} back to auto, sized to this machine

backends.allowedModelsHint: A regular expression; tier models must match it.
backends.sandboxHint: What Codex may touch on this computer.

hooks.unsupported: This version of the Seelegent service does not support hooks yet. They appear here once it does.
hooks.runHint: Runs in a shell; the event arrives as SEELEGENT_* environment variables.
hooks.invalid: Some hooks need fixing; see the marked fields.
hooks.unsaved: Not saved yet; save to test it.
hooks.testUnsupported: This version of the Seelegent service cannot test hooks yet (501 not implemented). The hook still runs on its events.

memory.noProjects: No projects yet. Memory belongs to a project folder, which appears here once a task ran there.
memory.none: Nothing saved for this project yet.
memory.changed: Someone else saved this project’s memory meanwhile.
memory.switchDesc: Your changes to {project}’s memory are not saved. Switching to another project drops them.

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: Colours of the whole dashboard. Auto follows your system’s light or dark mode.
theme.keywords: colour color dark light mode palette

fileIcons.label: File icons
fileIcons.desc: Icons next to file names in the Files, Git and process views and in the terminal.
fileIcons.keywords: icon icons file type seti material jetbrains catppuccin

fontUi.label: Interface font
fontUi.desc: Only fonts installed on this computer are used; nothing is downloaded.

fontMono.label: Code font
fontMono.desc: Font for logs, diffs and terminals. Theme default uses the theme’s pick.

sizeUi.label: Interface text size
sizeUi.desc: Base size of text across the dashboard.

sizeTerm.label: Code text size
sizeTerm.desc: Size of text in logs, diffs and terminals.

lineHeightTerm.label: Code line spacing
lineHeightTerm.desc: Space between lines in logs and terminals.

motion.label: Motion
motion.desc: Animations and transitions. System follows your reduced-motion setting.

reset.label: Reset appearance
reset.desc: Back to the default theme, fonts, sizes and motion.

locale.label: Language
locale.desc: Browser default follows the languages your browser prefers.

concurrency.label: Tasks per account
concurrency.desc: How many tasks one account may run at the same time.

defaultTier.label: Default tier
defaultTier.desc: Model tier used when a brief does not name one.

taskTimeout.label: Turn time limit
taskTimeout.desc: A turn that runs longer than this is stopped.

stall.label: Stuck after
stall.desc: A worker with no output for this long is marked as stalled.

stallTool.label: Stuck in a tool after
stallTool.desc: The same, while a tool or command is running (builds take longer).

loopRepeat.label: Loop detection
loopRepeat.desc: The same step repeated this many times counts as a loop. Effective up to 12: the check looks at the last 12 tool calls.

attentionDecay.label: Attention fades after
attentionDecay.desc: A task that needed you and was left alone drops out of “Needs you” after this long.

linkIntoProfiles.label: Shared into account profiles
linkIntoProfiles.desc: Folders and files in your home folder that every isolated account profile also sees (skills, configs).

backendAgy.label: Antigravity
backendAgy.desc: Gemini models through the Antigravity CLI.

backendCodex.label: Codex
backendCodex.desc: OpenAI models through Codex, with its sandbox.
backendCodex.keywords: codex openai gpt sandbox model tier

quotaReserve.label: Quota reserve
quotaReserve.desc: An account rests when a quota window has less than this left.

quotaRefresh.label: Read quota every
quotaRefresh.desc: How often each account’s quota is read.

passiveCooldown.label: API-key rest
passiveCooldown.desc: How long an API-key account rests after it hits a limit (its quota cannot be read).
passiveCooldown.keywords: cooldown passive api key rate limit

usageHistory.label: Keep usage history
usageHistory.desc: Record each account’s quota every hour for the Usage page.

providers.label: API providers
providers.desc: Anthropic-compatible services for Claude Code and OpenAI-compatible ones for Codex.
providers.keywords: provider api key base url deepseek openrouter openai

gates.label: Run gates
gates.desc: Run the task’s gate commands before it is handed to you for review.

gateAutoChecks.label: Find checks automatically
gateAutoChecks.desc: When a task names no gate, use the project’s build and test commands.

gateTimeout.label: Gate time limit
gateTimeout.desc: A gate command that runs longer than this fails.

gateMaxAutoFixes.label: Automatic fix rounds
gateMaxAutoFixes.desc: How many times a failed gate is sent back to the worker before you are asked.

gateSettle.label: Wait for files to settle
gateSettle.desc: Wait this long without file changes before running the gates.

gateSettlePoll.label: Settle check interval
gateSettlePoll.desc: How often files are checked while waiting for them to settle.

gateOutputTail.label: Gate output kept
gateOutputTail.desc: How much of the end of a gate’s output is kept and shown to the worker.

verifier.label: Second-opinion review
verifier.desc: Another worker reviews the change before it reaches you.

verifierTier.label: Reviewer tier
verifierTier.desc: Model tier of that second worker.

hygiene.label: Clean-up checks
hygiene.desc: Flag stray files, debug output and leftovers in a worker’s change.

gitGuard.label: Git guard
gitGuard.desc: Stop workers from committing, pushing or rewriting history.

lanes.label: File lanes
lanes.desc: When two tasks would edit the same files: off, warn, or keep the second one waiting.

laneHold.label: Lane hold
laneHold.desc: How long a finished task keeps its files reserved.

contentionWindow.label: Conflict window
contentionWindow.desc: How far back edits count when looking for tasks touching the same files.

snapshotRetention.label: Keep snapshots for
snapshotRetention.desc: Snapshots of the working folder taken before each turn are deleted after this long.

codeGraph.label: Code graph
codeGraph.desc: Give workers a map of the code’s symbols and calls.

port.label: Port
port.desc: The port the service and this dashboard listen on.

githubPoll.label: Check GitHub every
githubPoll.desc: How often tracked repositories are checked for new issues; 0 turns it off.

githubHosts.label: GitHub Enterprise hosts
githubHosts.desc: Hosts besides github.com that count as GitHub, one per line. A GitHub token is only ever sent to these hosts.

desktopNotify.label: Desktop notifications
desktopNotify.desc: Notify when a task needs review or a worker asks a question.

keymap.label: Shortcut keys
keymap.desc: See and change the keys for pages and commands.

webhooks.label: Hooks
webhooks.desc: Shell commands run when a task starts, finishes or fails, or an account needs you.

projectMemory.label: Project memory
projectMemory.desc: Conventions, commands and pitfalls added to every brief.

experimental.label: Experimental features
experimental.desc: Turn on features that are still being tested.

workerPriority.label: Worker priority
workerPriority.desc: Process priority of each worker and everything it starts. Low keeps the machine responsive while workers build and test. Applies from the next launch.
workerPriority.keywords: cpu priority nice below normal slow

gatePriority.label: Gate priority
gatePriority.desc: Process priority of gate commands, regression runs, automation checks and hooks. Low priority can make gates slower, so they may need a longer gate time limit.

maxWorkers.label: Workers at once
maxWorkers.desc: How many worker turns run at the same time over all accounts (each account keeps its own limit too). Lowering it stops nothing: it only holds new starts.

gateConcurrency.label: Gates at once
gateConcurrency.desc: How many gate commands and regression runs run at the same time. The others wait in line, and their time limit starts only when they start.

minFreeMemory.label: Free memory to start
minFreeMemory.desc: A new worker turn or gate command waits while the machine has less free memory (RAM) than this. The task shows “Waiting for resources”.
minFreeMemory.keywords: ram memory free threshold wait hold

minFreeCommit.label: Free commit to start
minFreeCommit.desc: The same for free commit (RAM plus page file).
minFreeCommit.keywords: commit page file swap virtual memory

criticalFreeMemory.label: Emergency memory floor
criticalFreeMemory.desc: Below this much free memory or commit, the newest running gate command is stopped and queued again, and every new start waits until memory is back above the start threshold. Workers are never stopped. When you set both, keep it below Free memory to start.

workerMemoryLimit.label: Worker memory cap
workerMemoryLimit.desc: Most memory each worker and everything it starts may use. A turn that reaches it fails with a message saying so; edits already on disk stay.

workerCpuRate.label: Worker CPU cap
workerCpuRate.desc: Most CPU each worker and everything it starts may use, as a percentage of the whole machine (all cores together).

testParallelism.label: Test parallelism
testParallelism.desc: How many packages or jobs tests and builds run at once: briefs ask workers to keep to it, and worker and gate environments get GOFLAGS=-p and CARGO_BUILD_JOBS.
testParallelism.keywords: parallel jobs go test cargo pytest maxworkers

daemonMemoryLimit.label: Service memory limit
daemonMemoryLimit.desc: Soft memory limit of the Seelegent service itself: it frees memory harder near it and is never stopped for it. A GOMEMLIMIT set for the service wins.
